settings.title: We build the whole yard, ourselves.

settings.editor: Cypress Hills started in 1994 with landscape construction and grew into a full design-build company. Today our crews handle pools, armour stone, outdoor living, lighting, putting greens and golf course shaping.
We keep the work in-house. The people who design your yard talk to the people who build it every day, and one project lead stays with you from the first site walk to the final walkthrough.
Over thirty years of building in Ontario soil and Ontario winters.
Clear plans, clear pricing, and straight answers about schedule.
One project lead and one number to call for the whole job.
One project lead walks with you from the first site visit to the day we hand it over.
We walk the property with you and listen to how you want to use it.
A drawn plan with materials and pricing, revised until it’s right.
Our own crews and machines build it piece by piece.
A final walkthrough, a handshake, and the keys are yours.
Caledon, Nobleton, King City, Vaughan, Kleinburg, Woodbridge, Muskoka, Collingwood, Toronto, and Surrounding Areas
